title.rendered: Paolo Casamassima has joined the Board of the GCMA representing Arqaam Capital

content.rendered:
Arqaam Capital is proud to share that Paolo Casamassima (Executive Director – Investor Relations & Stakeholder Engagement at Arqaam Capital) has joined the Board of The Gulf Capital Market Association (GCMA).

GCMA serves as the region’s leading industry platform, working with governments, regulators, exchanges, and the global investment community to strengthen market practices and support the continued evolution of GCC capital markets.

Paolo’s appointment reflects Arqaam Capital’s focus on advancing transparent, well-governed, and internationally aligned markets. Looking ahead, engagement will center on initiatives that support deeper liquidity, stronger investor access, and long-term capital formation across the GCC.

View More
